name: 08010 · Edgewater Prk, NJ
findings: ZIP 08010 (Edgewater Prk) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08010 (Edgewater Prk) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08010 (Edgewater Prk) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
